title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). translated_title: 学习引导大语言模型智能体与多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体与多智能体系统日益通过长时程工具使用和智能体间协作来处理复杂任务。然而，这些系统在执行过程中容易偏离总体目标，这不仅浪费执行资源，还会导致不理想的结果，这种失败被称为目标漂移（goal drift）。在本工作中，我们提出一种引导智能体，它能够在执行过程中实时监督，并在发生漂移时将系统引导回正轨。该引导智能体观察执行上下文，决定何时以低成本的快速路径进行干预，以及如何以高成本的慢速路径进行干预。为了释放其引导智能——即评估目标漂移并生成有效干预措施的能力——我们采用强化学习联合训练这两条路径，将成对排序目标与组相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合。在信息检索搜索任务上的实验表明，该方
tldr: 提出一种由强化学习联合训练的引导智能体，通过快速与慢速双路径实时检测并纠正大语言模型智能体及多智能体系统中的目标漂移，提升长时程任务执行的可靠性。
en_tdlr: A steering agent jointly trained with reinforcement learning (pairwise ranking + GRPO) monitors LLM agent and multi-agent executions in real time, detecting goal drift and intervening via fast and slow paths to keep systems on track.
